authority: Existing NativeRouteState is the sole serial authority; no concurrent mutation during search or between validation and acceptance.

topology.boundary: mask has at least two bits
topology.broadcast_domain: all SLR indices in the complete native graph and task metadata

summary.capacity: one distinct net per mutable electrical node

search.shared_tree: all tree nodes remain authoritative multi-source seeds; own-net occupancy is never double-counted
search.heuristic: existing consistent quotient hop lower bound; every traversed cost >=1
search.read_journal: all evaluated remote boundary costs, including nonselected alternatives
search.failed_outcomes: validate exhausted, label-budget, hop-limited and overflow outcomes as well as found paths

commit.validation: compare each observed occupancy/history/version against authority and check checkpoint epoch
commit.stale: discard speculative outcome and rerun once against current serial authority before accepting
commit.mutation: existing checked NativeRouteState.accept only; no speculative authority writes
commit.checkpoint_replacement: invalidate all previous views even when resource versions coincide

publication.interval: number of actual sparse searches, not logical loads already in the tree
publication.version: monotonic; equal version requires equal value

metrics.logical_deliveries: changed summaries times (die_count-1), including final drain; zero-state baseline implicit

limitations: Boundary overlay atop serial authority, not die-local partitioned authority or concurrent native routing.
No corridor reservation or task migration added by this protocol.
Existing hop/congestion objective and frozen-outside cohort scope remain; no timing/QoR improvement claim.
No hardware message encoding, network/HBM counters, accelerator implementation or board result.
